additionalProperties.description_en:
When contentType is set to JSON, the contentDetail parameter contains the following fields:
enableTag
Required: yes
Type: Boolean
Description: Specifies whether to ship the tag field.
Valid values:
    - true
      - Description: Ships the tag field.
      - Example: {"enableTag": true}
    - false
      - Description: Does not ship the tag field.
      - Example: {"enableTag": false}

When contentType is set to csv, the contentDetail parameter contains the following fields:
columns
Required: yes
Type: array
Description: The keys of logs in the source Logstore.
Example: {"columns":["a", "b", "c", "d"]}
delimiter
Required: yes
Type: string
Description: The delimiter between content fields.
Valid values: ",", "|", " ", or ""
header
Required: yes
Type: Boolean
Description: Specifies whether to write field names to the first row of the CSV file.
Valid values:
    - true
    - false
lineFeed
Required: no
Type: string
Description: The custom line feed character.
Valid values: "", "
", or ""
Default value: "
"
null
Required: no
Type: string
Description: The custom placeholder for invalid fields.
Default value: ""
quote
Required: yes
Type: string
Description: The custom escape character.
Valid values: `"\""`, "'", or ""
  Full example: {"null": "-", "header": false, "lineFeed": "
", "quote": "", "delimiter": ",", "columns": ["a", "b", "c", "d"]}

When contentType is set to parquet, the contentDetail parameter contains the following fields:
columns
Required: yes
Type: array
Description: The keys of logs in the source Logstore.
Example: {"columns": [{"name": "a", "type": "string"}, {"name": "b", "type": "string"}, {"name": "c", "type": "string"},{"name": "d", "type": "string"}]}

When contentType is set to orc, the contentDetail parameter contains the following fields:
columns
Required: yes
Type: array
Description: The keys of logs in the source Logstore.
Example: {"columns": [{"name": "a", "type": "string"}, {"name": "b", "type": "string"}, {"name": "c", "type": "string"},{"name": "d", "type": "string"}]}
additionalProperties.description_zh:
contentType值为JSON时，contentDetail值的详细参数：
enableTag
是否必填：是
类型：布尔
描述：是否投递 tag字段
值：
    - true
      - 描述：投递 tag字段
      - 示例：{"enableTag": true}
    - false
      - 描述：不投递 tag字段
      - 示例：{"enableTag": false}

contentType值为csv时，contentDetail值的详细参数：
columns
是否必填：是
类型：数组
描述：源日志库中日志的key
示例：{"columns":["a", "b", "c", "d"]}
delimiter
是否必填：是
类型：字符串
描述：内容间分隔符
值：","、"|"、" " 或 "\t"
header
是否必填：是
类型：布尔
描述：是否将字段名称写入CSV文件（第一行）
值：
    - true
    - false
lineFeed
是否必填：否
类型：字符串
描述：自定义换行符
值："\t"、"\n" 或 ""
默认值："\n"
null
是否必填：否
类型：字符串
描述：自定义无效字段的填充值
默认值：""
quote
是否必填：是
类型：字符串
描述：自定义转义符
值：`"\""`、"'" 或 ""
  完整示例：{"null": "-", "header": false, "lineFeed": "\n", "quote": "", "delimiter": ",", "columns": ["a", "b", "c", "d"]}

contentType值为parquet时，contentDetail值的详细参数：
columns
是否必填：是
类型：数组
描述：源日志库中日志的key
示例：{"columns": [{"name": "a", "type": "string"}, {"name": "b", "type": "string"}, {"name": "c", "type": "string"},{"name": "d", "type": "string"}]}

contentType值为orc时，contentDetail值的详细参数：
columns
是否必填：是
类型：数组
描述：源日志库中日志的key
示例：{"columns": [{"name": "a", "type": "string"}, {"name": "b", "type": "string"}, {"name": "c", "type": "string"},{"name": "d", "type": "string"}]}
additionalProperties.example:
{
    "columns": [
        "your log key1",
        "your log key2",
        "your log key3",
    ],
    "delimiter": " ",
    "header": true,
    "lineFeed": "\n",
    "null": "-",
    "quote": "\""
},
